description: The state the page is built for: work genuinely in progress, ticked by different people on different days, with some decisions still open. This is where the shared-state argument either holds or falls over — the reversible steps are done and attributed, S6 sits amber because D3 and D4 are still unanswered, and the banner reports both at once. It is also the mixed case the wording has to survive: a count, a blocked step, and a set of ready ones in the same sentence.
